abstract: FEZrs is an open-source Python package for geospatial multispectral image processing and remote sensing. It puts thirty-seven operations (spectral indices, filters, image enhancement, GLCM texture, PCA, K-Means clustering, change detection and SVM classification) behind one three-line calling pattern. Each calculator can save a figure with execute() and a georeferenced GeoTIFF with to_raster().
